title: Sena Rise and Lakshman Sen Court Culture
subtitle: Dynastic expansion and a major phase of courtly-literary life in Bengal.
summary: The Sena period marked dynastic expansion, consolidation of elite Hindu court culture, and notable patronage of Sanskrit and Bengali literary-intellectual activity, especially under Lakshman Sen.
heroTagline: Dynastic expansion and a major phase of courtly-literary life in Bengal.
whyItMatters: Understanding this phase helps explain social hierarchy, literary change, and the political landscape immediately before the 1204 conquest.
